name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
outcome: Coordinate bounded coding tasks across multiple agents while retaining human approval and traceable integration.
description: Decompose a software change into independent tasks, isolate agent work and integrate reviewed outputs. Compare a single-agent workflow with a coordinated one; avoid unnecessary parallelism.
learn: Choose when parallel agent work is justified
Coordinate isolated tasks with explicit handoff contracts
Resolve conflicts and validate the integrated result
tools: Claude Code CLI or Codex CLI (choose one)
prior: Git branches, merges and conflict resolution; Python and shell basics
practice: Split a small extension of the SSC scientific Python project into two independent changes; execute on isolated branches and integrate after review.
acceptance: Each task has a clear contract, bounded execution and independent tests. The merged result passes integration checks, and the comparison records limitations.
external: Git branches, merges and conflict resolution; Python and shell basics
moduleDescriptions: Identify independent tasks, shared interfaces and a measurable baseline.
Assign bounded work in separate worktrees with restricted permissions.
Exchange structured results, review diffs and resolve a planned conflict.
Measure task completion, cost or time, and integration quality against the single-agent baseline.
prerequisiteRationale: S05 provides the controlled lifecycle, approval gates and traceable handoffs that must survive parallel execution.
